instruction.text: Do you know what a telescope looks like? Select the correct picture.
What are people who study the universe and outer space called? Select all correct answers.

feedback.end: Correct! In the past, space was only studied by astronomers, but now, there are also modern physicists that work in the field of astronomy. They are called astrophysicists.

atoms.b: In ancient times, ((++astronomers astrologers)) followed a geocentric model and thought that all ((++planets astronauts)) in the entire universe revolved around the Earth.

hint.text: The prefix geo comes from Gaia, the ancient Greek Earth goddess.
hint.label: Geocentric

atoms.b: It was only in the 16th century that a heliocentric model was recognised by astronomers. This meant the ((++Sun Venus)) was now understood to be the centre of our ((++solar lunar)) system.

hint.text: The prefix helio comes from Helios, the ancient Greek Sun god.
hint.label: Heliocentric

atoms.b: Nowadays, ((++astrophysicists astrophysicians)) continue to study space using modern technology, leading to new theories about our ((++universe university)).

instruction.text: Are the following statements true or false?

atoms.a: Astronomers and astrophysicists use microscopes to study space.
Nowadays, people use the heliocentric model.
